subject.name: The Kelton
subject.location_note: Verified against the Utah County LIR parcel footprint for 'Kelton Apartments Phase 1 Plat' (serials 44-238-0002..0015, situs 301 S 1100 W, built 2023). The US Census geocoder mis-matched the mailing address to '301 N 1100 E' (~2.9 mi ENE, wrong quadrant); overridden to the true parcel-union centroid.

mailing_geocode.note: wrong quadrant (N/E vs S/W) - rejected in favor of parcel footprint

analysis_area.note: 2-mile radius around the verified subject point. Captures west/central American Fork and east/central Lehi (the immediate competitive supply area). The broader 5-mile competitive set is covered by the separate supply-chart workstream.

parcel_sources.name: Utah County Parcels LIR (UGRC statewide LIR schema)

owner_source.name: Utah County Parcels (UGRC, ownership schema)
owner_source.note: The LIR schema withholds owner names; owner is joined on PARCEL_ID from UGRC's companion ownership layer (same host).

landuse_enrich.note: Synthetic land-use code is derived per parcel from the county PROP_CLASS plus the mass-appraisal building type (BLDG_SQFT_INFO). PROP_CLASS='Vacant' -> VAC; 'Tax Exempt' -> EXEMPT; otherwise the building type carves out Apartments/Multifamily, Commercial, Industrial, Agricultural, and Institutional, falling back to Residential=SF and Unknown/blank=OTHER. See decisions log section 4.

landuse_scheme.name: Utah County LIR PROP_CLASS + county building type (BLDG_SQFT_INFO) -> synthetic land-use codes
landuse_scheme.vacant_note: County assessor PROP_CLASS = 'Vacant' (unimproved/vacant class). Agricultural greenbelt land is classed Agricultural/Rural, not Vacant, and is not counted as a by-right apartment site.
landuse_scheme.public_owner_regex: (AMERICAN FORK CITY|LEHI CITY|SARATOGA SPRINGS|PLEASANT GROVE|HIGHLAND CITY|CEDAR HILLS|ALPINE CITY|UTAH COUNTY|STATE OF UTAH|\bUDOT\b|UNITED STATES|\bUSA\b|ALPINE SCHOOL|SCHOOL DIST|\bDISTRICT\b|UNIVERSITY|CEMETERY|\bCHURCH\b|PRESIDING BISHOP|CORP OF THE PRESIDING|LATTER.?DAY|\bLDS\b|IRRIGATION|WATER DISTRICT|METROPOLITAN WATER)

MF: Multi-unit residential building (county building type = apartments / multiple-residence / N-unit / tri-fourplex / duplex / group or senior housing)
SF: Single-family / detached dwelling (PROP_CLASS Residential or single-family building type)
COM: Retail / office / hotel / service (PROP_CLASS Commercial with a non-industrial building type)
IND: Warehouse / manufacturing / distribution / storage / auto-service building type
AG: Agricultural / farm building type or rural land
EXEMPT: PROP_CLASS Tax Exempt, or public / institutional owner or building type
OTHER: No county property class or building-type signal on record (includes some condo and utility parcels)
